regional_interpretation.summary: The closest coordinate-verified geoacoustic controls recovered in this pass are the Kouilou/Regab pockmark systems roughly 679-683 km east to east-southeast of the frozen point.
regional_interpretation.geological_relation: They occupy the Congo deep-sea fan / Congo-Angola margin seep province. The frozen point is a separate offshore location; no continuous tectonic, sedimentary or acoustic structure connecting them has been established.
regional_interpretation.scientific_use: Use the pockmark systems as nearby regional natural controls for unusual backscatter, gas-related reflectors, cavities, hydrates, carbonate crusts and fluid-flow signatures, not as evidence that the frozen point contains the same geology.
